title: The past-ruling check on a pick also covers triage's picks
why: PR #2932 (step pick-ack-past-ruling) checks only a coordinator's picks: hooks/call_judge.py is_coordinator is true only for a session tagged cs-build:coordinator. Triage made two picks on mutation-tests-for-cost tonight (08:00 and 09:05 CST) that missed decision ci-job-caps and the GUARD_MODULE_EXEMPT list (sightings 9 and 10).
note: Fix after #2932 merges: the check also judges a pick or hold sent by a session tagged cs-build:triage. Red first: a triage pick that a decision on main settles is flagged; a coordinator pick still is.
